name: Yew staff
description: Dark, fine-grained and slightly warm to the touch. Sorcerers say it listens; the bursar says it was expensive.
notes: A fine staff; no moves of its own yet, like the ash staff. Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, staves 60-140 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
